descriptions.chronicle: Your journey leaves its mark here.
descriptions.door: The door leads to the menu. The Forge will be here when you return.

tutorial.intro: I will tell you how the Forge works. Touch the place you want to hear about.
tutorial.again: Touch another place or close our talk.
tutorial.end: Those are all the rules the Forge follows today. The Tutorial stays in the menu whenever you want to come back.

hearth.1: At the hearth you choose a workout: running, strength training or mobility.
hearth.2: You set a start, now or at a time you choose, and a later deadline to finish by.
hearth.3: Before you make the Oath, you see all its rules. It is made only when you explicitly accept them.
hearth.4: Once it is made, no one can change its rules, not even the Forge. A different promise means a new Oath.

seals.1: The seals are your current Oaths: scheduled, active and those awaiting a result.
seals.2: Each Oath keeps its times in its own timezone. Changing your phone’s timezone does not move them.
seals.3: The Forge decides the state, not your phone’s clock. After the last deadline the Oath is under review, not missed.

chronicle.1: The chronicle keeps your finished Oaths and their results.
chronicle.2: Nobody rewrites the chronicle. Each Oath keeps the rules you accepted when you made it.

door.1: The door leads to the menu. There you can switch characters or create a new one, up to three.
door.2: Each character has its own Oaths, chronicle and pause.
door.3: When you turn it on in Settings, pause withdraws this character’s scheduled and active Oaths. Those awaiting a result continue.
door.4: While paused you cannot make a new Oath. Resuming lifts the pause but does not restore withdrawn Oaths.

scheduled.0: The Oath is waiting for its start. It helps to know where you will train.
scheduled.1: There is still time before the start. Get ready whenever you like.
scheduled.2: The start is set. Think about when and where you will begin.
scheduled.3: There is nothing to do until the start. The Oath begins on its own.
scheduled.4: The plan is in place. When the time comes, I will be at the hearth.

active.0: The Oath is under way. Once the workout is done, submit your proof.
active.1: Time is on your side. Pick a time and place that suit you.
active.2: The fire burns steady. Workout first, then proof, at your own pace.
active.3: There is still time before the deadline. It helps to know when you will set out.
active.4: After the workout, come back here with your proof. I will wait by the seal.

activeSoon.0: The deadline is near. This is a good moment to set out.
activeSoon.1: Under an hour left. If the workout is behind you, submit your proof.
activeSoon.2: The fire is burning low and the deadline is close. Set out as soon as you can.
activeSoon.3: The deadline is close. Workout now, proof right after.

cutoff.0: The proof window is still open. Submit your proof if the workout ended by the deadline.
cutoff.1: If the workout ended by the deadline, the proof can still make it.
cutoff.2: The candle is still burning. If the workout ended by the deadline, submit your proof now.

interrupted.0: That is not your fault. Just send the copy again.

assessing.0: Your proof has arrived. Now we wait for the assessment together.
assessing.1: The proof is in the Forge now. You can get on with your day.
assessing.2: Proof submitted, that was an important step. You can rest now.
assessing.3: The fire has done its part, and now comes the assessment. Nothing more is needed for now.
assessing.4: Your part is done. The rest is now up to the assessment.

review.0: The Forge is still weighing this Oath.

fulfilled.0: You did it. This workout is now part of your path.
fulfilled.1: Word kept. Another Oath whenever you like.
fulfilled.2: The fire has accepted this workout. Good, steady work.
fulfilled.3: A fulfilled Oath is another step on the trail. Rest before you go on.
fulfilled.4: This workout counts. The hearth is ready for the next Oath.

missed.0: The hearth is ready for a new Oath. We can set out whenever you want.
missed.1: Your earlier marks stay in the chronicle. When you want, we can forge a new Oath.
missed.2: The next Oath can be smaller, sized to fit your day. The hearth will wait.

unresolved.0: The fire still burns. A new Oath can begin whenever you like.
unresolved.1: Having no outcome is not a failure. The hearth is waiting for another Oath whenever you like.

withdrawn.0: This Oath is behind you now. A new one can begin whenever you like.
withdrawn.1: The pause was your choice. The hearth is waiting for a new Oath.
withdrawn.2: Good to have you back. We can forge a new Oath when you want.

confirmed.0: Your word is given. Think about when and where you will train.
confirmed.1: Your word is forged. Now the workout, at your own pace, then the proof.
confirmed.2: The seal is set. Pick a time and place that fit your day.

confirmedScheduled.0: The start is set. Until then, you can get ready calmly.
confirmedScheduled.1: Your word is forged and waits for its start. It helps to know where you will train then.

proofScreen.0: Three steps: type, image and confirmation. We will take them in order.
proofScreen.1: Choose the type, add an image, confirm. The Forge does the rest.
proofScreen.2: Proof is just three steps. Start with the type.
